newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty firms, depos hold near 25-pct lombard rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty firms, depos hold near 25-pct lombard rate.

text.p: 1245 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 1.53/1.26 pct from the trading band centre, stronger than Tuesday's close at 0.31/0.24 pct after the fiance minister said that the main wave of zloty-depressing foreign investor withdrawal has ended.
* It closed at 3.1970/70 to the dollar, up from 3.2300/30 on Tuesday and at 1.7880/20 to the mark, up from 1.9015/22.
* Some foreign investors bought Polish treasuries to take advantage of the relatively cheap zloty, and accelerated the local unit's rise in late trade.
* O/N, T/N close flat at 24.10/25.0 and 23.7/24.7 pct, as the market remained dry in the last days of May's reserve.
